visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A golden-brown star-shaped pastry sits on a white marble plate. Gloved hands pull apart a segment, revealing a flaky interior and a piece of chicken. The background is a blurred kitchen setting with a neutral-toned table. Large white text overlays the top. (2) In a glass bowl, hands use a red spatula to mix a block of white cream cheese with chopped red onions, green scallions, and black pepper. The setting is a light-colored wooden table under bright indoor lighting. Yellow subtitles appear at the bottom. (3) A round piece of dough is placed on a wooden board. Hands spread the white filling mixture evenly across the surface and then arrange several strips of orange-colored chicken breast. A second layer of dough is placed on top. (4) A close-up shows a golden fork pressing into the edge of the dough circle to seal it, creating a decorative ridge. The wooden surface and bright lighting persist. Yellow text appears at the bottom explaining the sealing process. (5) A blue plastic bottle cap with white text is placed in the center of the dough. A knife cuts the dough from the cap to the edge into twelve radial segments. The hands are wearing clear plastic gloves. (6) Each cut segment is twisted twice by the hands to create a spiral effect, revealing the chicken and cream cheese filling inside. The camera captures a close-up of the delicate folding process on the wooden board. (7) A yellow egg wash is brushed over the twisted segments using a small container, followed by a sprinkle of black and white sesame seeds. The pastry now sits on a piece of brown parchment paper. (8) The pastry is shown inside a modern oven behind a glass door. As it bakes, the dough puffs up and turns a deep golden color. The oven light provides a warm glow against the dark interior. (9) The final baked pastry is presented back on the marble plate. Close-up shots show the crispy texture and steam as segments are lifted. White and yellow text overlays provide a final brand call to action.
